name: Thaumaturgical Rituals — Basic — Deflection of Wooden Doom

system.description: After sitting in a circle of wood for a full hour and placing a splinter under your tongue, the first stake to actually pierce your heart crumbles to dust before the next dusk or dawn, ending the ritual's protection.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Until next dusk or dawn, or until triggered
